content: Root cause: The original test logic in TServerUtilsTest was failing because the ServerSocket was binding to all available network interfaces, leading to unexpected behavior when the test attempted to bind the same port again. This caused the test to not accurately expect an exception when trying to bind to a port that was already in use, as the binding to all interfaces allowed other instances of ServerSocket to use the same port without conflict. The patch fixed this by explicitly binding the ServerSocket to the "localhost" interface, ensuring that subsequent attempts to bind to the same port within the same testing context would lead to the desired failure when an exception was expected.
